theorems.statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (P : ℂ → ℂ) (p : FormalMultilinearSeries ℂ ℂ ℂ), 0 < w → HasFPowerSeriesAt P p 0 → (∀ n : ℕ, ¬ w ∣ n → p.coeff n = 0) → ∃ C : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticAt ℂ C 0 ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ t : ℂ, ‖t‖ < r → P t = C (t ^ w)
